# U-001 Widget Approval module

## Hard rules
- Every stage transition delegated to `WorkflowEngine::transition()`
- Form Requests for transition actions extend `MakerCheckerRequest`

## Implementation steps
1. Run the controller generator for `WidgetController`.
2. `store(StoreWidgetRequest $request)` -> Maker draft.
3. `approve(ApproveWidgetRequest $request)` -> Checker stage.
4. `confirm(ConfirmWidgetRequest $request)` -> Confirmer stage.

## Target files
```
app/Http/Controllers/WidgetController.php
app/Http/Requests/StoreWidgetRequest.php
app/Http/Requests/ApproveWidgetRequest.php
app/Http/Requests/ConfirmWidgetRequest.php
app/DataTables/WidgetsDataTable.php
resources/views/widgets/{index,create,show}.blade.php
routes/web.php (edit)
tests/Feature/Controllers/WidgetControllerTest.php
```

## Tests
- `test_store_creates_widget`
- `test_approve_advances_to_approved`

## Acceptance
- ✅ Full 3-stage flow drives a widget draft -> CONFIRMED
